title: Copilot setup steps: lint tool caches are restore-only and must use the same paths and keys as lint.yml
answers: Why does the Copilot cloud agent setup spend most of its time before the agent starts working?
How do I add or change a cache (mypy, pre-commit, install-bin, action pins) used by the Copilot agent environment?
Where are the lint cache keys that the Copilot setup restores defined?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml, the job Copilot cloud agent reads from the default branch to prepare each agent session: checkout, the setup-node/setup-python/setup-java actions, four cache restores (action pins, mypy, install-bin tools, pre-commit hooks), then `uv sync --only-group lint`.
Rule: The four cache steps use `actions/cache/restore` only, never `actions/cache`, so .github/workflows/lint.yml stays the sole writer. Each step's `path`, `key` and `restore-keys` must match the corresponding save in .github/workflows/lint.yml (for example `mypy-ubuntu-latest-` and `pre-commit-ubuntu-latest-` prefixes keyed on uv.lock/pyproject.toml or .pre-commit-config.yaml). When you change a lint cache key or path, change both files in the same PR.
Symptom: Agent session setup took about 48s of controllable work before the agent started, and on real sessions setup consumed about 38s out of 122s total; a key or path that drifted from lint.yml produces silent misses instead of restores.
Constraints: Applies to the cache steps of the Copilot setup workflow. The restore-only pattern is deliberate, so do not add save steps here. Does not cover cache writes in lint.yml itself.
applies: Edits to cache steps or lint cache keys that the Copilot cloud agent setup workflow depends on; does not cover other workflows' caches.
says: Why does the Copilot agent setup take so long before it starts working on my task?
How do I change a cache path or key used in the Copilot agent environment setup?
Copilot agent session setup spends too long restoring lint caches; how do I fix it?
Where are the lint cache keys that the Copilot setup restores defined?
search: Copilot cloud agent setup workflow restores lint caches (action pins, mypy, install-bin tools, pre-commit hooks) restore-only, with paths and keys that must match lint.yml's saves. Changing a lint cache key or path requires editing both files in the same PR. Do not add save steps to the setup workflow.
